Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner first misinterpreted “Governor of the City” as referring to a Vatican City office (“i.e., Vatican City”) rather than the historical Papal office “Governor of the City (of Rome).” This wrong framing derailed the research path, preventing a direct lookup of the Rome office (which ended in 1870) and led the team to chase Vatican City governance instead.
